title: Runtime pair lock (ODOC-328): lore X must refuse to drive quest != X
description: Operator-directed (ODOC-OP-2026-09-29-02), binding text read by ref at opum-doc origin/main docs/adr/lock-lore-and-quest-to-their-exact-pair-version-at-runtime.md (Accepted 2026-09-29, ODOC-328): lore X runs only against quest X, compared on the full version; a mismatch FAILS (not a warning) naming both installed versions and the side to upgrade; lore checks the quest it drives. Open details (exit code, message text, hook point) are lore-cli's to propose through opum-agent (OPAG-748). PROPOSED (sent to opum-agent 2026-09-29): single boundary at the quest adapter's probe()/ensure() gate in src/adapters/quest.ts (every quest-backed command passes through it by construction); exit 6 error_type validation with input.code quest.version-pair-mismatch; message 'the lore X / quest Y pair version requirement is not met: lore X requires quest X' + hint naming the install of the side behind. Alternative proposed: a per-command assertPair() guard. Implementation is dispatched only after the operator's decision and ships in a pair release (Article 3). Do not start implementation before that.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The proposal (recommended hook point + one alternative, each with quality/speed/cost, plus exit code and exact message text) is sent to opum-agent for OPAG-748 and ledgered there.

After the operator decision: lore refuses to drive a quest whose full version differs from lore's own, exiting 6 with a message naming both installed versions and the side to upgrade; the refusal is covered by a test proving both directions and the exact-match rule. Ships in a pair release (Article 3); no standalone release.
